description: Join Chintu the elephant and Mithu the parrot on a colorful magical kite adventure! A fun learning video for toddlers.
learning: Teaching colors and excitement through magical kite flying.

scenes.text: Arrey! Dekho, ye magic kite kahan se aayi?
scenes.image_prompt: 3D CGI render, vertical 9:16, close up of a cute round orange baby elephant Chintu looking surprised at a sparkling glowing kite floating in the sky, bright sunny park background, soft cinematic lighting.

scenes.text: Mithu, catch the magic kite! Fly high!
scenes.image_prompt: 3D CGI render, vertical 9:16, tiny green parrot Mithu with a red cap flapping wings fast, chasing a glittering golden kite, dynamic motion blur, vibrant blue sky.

scenes.text: Wow! Chintu ne pakdi rang-birangi dori!
scenes.image_prompt: 3D CGI render, vertical 9:16, Chintu elephant holding a colorful string attached to the magic kite, he is wearing a blue scarf, happy expressive face, grassy field.

scenes.text: Zoom zoom, up up! Chalo udte hain!
scenes.image_prompt: 3D CGI render, vertical 9:16, Chintu and Mithu dancing and jumping with excitement, the magic kite sparkling in the air above them, colorful flowers around.

scenes.text: Red, Blue, Yellow! Kite changes colors!
scenes.image_prompt: 3D CGI render, vertical 9:16, the kite in mid-air changing colors rapidly, Chintu pointing his trunk at the kite in wonder, bright colorful park setting.

scenes.text: Spin, spin, spin! Magic magic ho gaya!
scenes.image_prompt: 3D CGI render, vertical 9:16, Chintu spinning in joy with Mithu flying around his head, magical sparkles trailing from the kite, toddler-friendly cute art style.

scenes.text: Haha! Kitna maza aaya, kite dance!
scenes.image_prompt: 3D CGI render, vertical 9:16, Chintu elephant laughing out loud with wide sparkly eyes, Mithu parrot sitting on his shoulder, both very happy, sunny day.

scenes.text: Ruko! Magic kite phir se wapas aayi!
scenes.image_prompt: 3D CGI render, vertical 9:16, Chintu looking directly at the camera with wide eyes and a surprised expression, the kite floating back into the frame, high energy.
